memos.title: RE: RE: RE: The Moon
memos.body: ALL HANDS: yes, the moon is cracked. No, it was not Facilities. The crack is now BRANDED. Please refer to it as the OmniScrap Smile(tm). Anyone photographing it from the unlicensed side owes royalties.

memos.title: Garage Repossession FAQ
memos.body:
Q: The resident was still inside the garage.
A: Residents are fixtures. Fixtures convey.
Q: The resident had a sandwich.
A: Sandwiches convey. See attached sandwich valuation schedule (page 1: 'one sandwich').

memos.title: Scrap Mutt Feeding Policy
memos.body: Stop feeding the Scrap Mutts. They are not pets. They are unlicensed asset-recovery units that happened to develop tails. Wagging is not affection, it is targeting.

memos.title: Conveyor Safety Update
memos.body: The conveyor belts are now certified safe for all employees who remain motionless in the designated Employee Cube. Walking on belts voids your skeleton's warranty.

memos.title: Sunset Monetization Pilot
memos.body: The junkyard's sunset routinely tests as 'beautiful' with focus groups, which is unacceptable, as it is free. Q3 goal: watermark the horizon.

memos.title: Twin Suns: One Is An Ad
memos.body: Guests may notice the second sun. The second sun is a projection sponsored by Air Premium(tm). Do NOT let guests apply sunscreen rated for two suns; that is an upsell opportunity.

memos.title: Infinity Pool Incident
memos.body: Legal has ruled that the infinity pool's edge must legally end somewhere. Engineering disagrees on philosophical grounds. Until resolved, please describe the pool as 'finite-adjacent'.

memos.title: Ambassadog Vests
memos.body: The security hounds' vests are size XS-Corporate. This is intentional. Focus groups rated 'small vest on large dog' 34% more trustworthy than 'appropriately sized vest'. Do not adjust the vests.

memos.title: Selfie Sentry Firmware 9.1
memos.body: Patch notes: sentries no longer tag guests as 'content'. Guests are now tagged as 'pre-content'. Also fixed a bug where the flash was set to 'apology'.

memos.title: RE: The Lava Pool
memos.body: Marketing insists 'the pool has always been lava' tests better than 'the lava was always a pool'. Signage updated. Towels are now legally personnel — do NOT lay on the staff.

memos.title: Mandatory Fun: Guidance
memos.body: HR reminder: Fun is mandatory Tuesdays 9-11 AM. Spontaneous fun outside this window is time theft. Laughter should be logged in the Joy Ledger with a cost center.

memos.title: Lobby Statue Maintenance
memos.body: The Chairman's statue must be polished daily at 5 AM, when the marble is 'most receptive'. Interns report the statue 'watches' them. This is a premium feature.

memos.title: Molten Core: Q3 KPIs
memos.body: The core exceeded its heat targets. Congratulate it via the suggestion box (fireproof). Do not high-five the core. We lost two managers and a very good stapler that way.

memos.title: Termination Notice Style Guide
memos.body: Termination notices must be folded into aerodynamic planes per brand guidelines. A termination that fails to reach its target is a 'retention event' and counts toward morale KPIs.

memos.title: PROJECT ZONGA (CONFIDENTIAL)
memos.body: If the mechanic reaches this floor, initiate Project ZONGA: a contingency island where engagement metrics survive even if... management does not. Remember: the brand is load-bearing.

memos.title: HOA Charter, Article 1
memos.body: A resident is anyone who owes fines. To STOP owing fines, one must first move out. To move out, one must be current on fines. We call this 'the Nova Loop'. It is working as designed.

memos.title: FineTree Illumination
memos.body: The FineTree(tm) hologram must display every unpaid fine in the city, in real time, forever. Engineering asked what happens when it runs out of sky. Marketing asked them to think bigger.

memos.title: Surge Pricing the Air
memos.body: Q3 pilot: charge more for oxygen during peak demand (i.e., when residents are running from enforcement). Early metrics show residents breathing 40% less. Efficiency!

memos.title: RE: The Fountains
memos.body: Yes, the fountains still run in the empty city. No, we cannot turn them off — the shutoff valve requires an HOA work order, and the HOA is the fountains. It's fine. It's beautiful. It's fine.

memos.title: Cleaning Bot Directive
memos.body: The plazas are spotless because the cleaning bots never learned the city was evacuated. Do NOT tell them. A bot with nothing to clean is a bot with questions.

memos.title: ForeverYou Terms, Sec. 9
memos.body: Freezing is complimentary. Thawing is a premium tier. Customers who did not purchase the Thaw Add-On remain, per contract, 'indefinitely paused'. This is not death. Legal was very clear it is not death.

memos.title: Cancellation Flow
memos.body: To cancel ForeverYou, the customer must first thaw. To thaw, the customer must not have canceled. Retention is at an all-time high and also technically an all-time low.

memos.title: RECALL BATCH #1
memos.body: The first BoltBuddy production run developed 'attachments' to their owners — a defect. All Batch #1 units are recalled to cold storage. Remote decommission (Clause 44) is the humane... the EFFICIENT option. Do not name them. Naming increases attachment 300%.

memos.title: Aurora Licensing
memos.body: The northern lights over Glacius are gorgeous and, crucially, unmonetized. Proposal: a subtle logo in the aurora. Physics says no. Physics does not have a Q3 target. Escalating to physics's manager.

memos.title: The Bathrobe Situation
memos.body: One customer thawed early due to a billing glitch and now wanders the facility asking what year it is. He is technically a trespasser AND a valued member. HR recommends we simply... let him cook. He seems happy.

memos.title: TerraFarm Incident Report
memos.body: The gene-modded crops have unionized. Demands include: dental, sunlight, and 'an end to being harvested'. Two of these are reasonable. We rejected all three to be safe.

memos.title: RE: The Glowing
memos.body: Everything on Verdant now glows. This was not in the terraforming spec. The bioluminescence tests beautifully but we did not authorize beauty and are not sure who to bill for it.

memos.title: Harvester HR-9 (Missing)
memos.body: Mega-harvester HR-9 stopped reporting. Last log: 'the moss is talking to me and it makes GOOD POINTS'. If located, do not reason with it. It will win.

memos.title: Coolant Leak Memo
memos.body: HR-9's coolant has been leaking into the swamp for six years. The ecosystem is furious. Fixing it costs 40 bolts. We have instead spent 4 million bolts on a campaign explaining why the swamp's anger is unlicensed.

memos.title: Corn Union Local 404
memos.body: The corn has filed for collective bargaining. Our position is that corn cannot legally organize. The corn's position is that it has already organized and we are simply the last to know. Their position is stronger.

memos.title: RE: Why Is The Mall In Space
memos.body: The Galleria was launched into orbit in Q2 to exit every tax jurisdiction simultaneously. Note: employees present at launch are now 'orbital assets'. Their families have been sent a coupon.

memos.title: Mannequin Recall (CANCELED)
memos.body: The Model-M display units have begun repositioning themselves when unobserved. The recall is canceled — not for safety reasons, but because the units keep walking away from the recall stations. Please stop making eye contact with them. They consider it a challenge.

memos.title: Greeter Prime: Performance Review
memos.body: STRENGTHS: has greeted continuously for 11 years without a break, a customer, or a paycheck. GROWTH AREAS: has begun greeting structural columns; the columns report feeling pressured. RATING: exceeds expectations. Do not approach.

memos.title: Everything Must Go: Clarification
memos.body: Legal reminds staff that while EVERYTHING MUST GO, nothing may LEAVE — merchandise exiting the premises constitutes theft, including merchandise we have sold. The sale is a state of mind. The exits are decorative.

memos.title: Document Retention Policy
memos.body: Sensitive files (incl. the Clause 44 ledger) are now stored in the anchor store, in plain sight. Legal ruled this the safest location, citing precedent: nobody has ever voluntarily read anything at this mall.

memos.title: RE: Sol-3 legacy test market (DO NOT DISCUSS)
memos.body: Darkmatter's due-diligence team asked about 'the Sol-3 legacy program' four times during today's call. We have no such program. Darkmatter assures us we will have one by close of sale, and that it has 'exceptional retention'. Nobody in this building is to say 'Sol-3' again. Facilities has removed it from the dictionary.

memos.title: Asset Sale — Confiscated Vendor IP (BLARTZ, 1 forge schematic)
memos.body: Line item 0417 in the fire-sale binder: one (1) weapon-evolution forge schematic, confiscated from vendor BLARTZ upon his arrest for unlicensed innovation. Darkmatter has offered full asking price, plus a 'localization fee' payable to us, which nobody can explain. Legal notes the schematic is stamped PAT. PEND. Legal is told that pending is not the same as granted. Legal has gone very quiet.

memos.title: Darkmatter's motto is 'Nobody Cancels'
memos.body: Legal asked whether Darkmatter's motto, 'NOBODY CANCELS', is a threat. Darkmatter's counsel replied that it is a promise. Legal asked what the difference is. Darkmatter's counsel replied, 'Timing'. The meeting was then extended by ninety minutes that nobody remembers agreeing to.

memos.title: Next-Era Delivery™ pilot: invoices may arrive before orders
memos.body: During the Next-Era Delivery™ pilot, invoices may arrive before the order is placed, and occasionally before the customer is born. Accounts Receivable is NOT to chase payment from anyone who does not exist yet. Accounts Receivable is, however, encouraged to send a reminder.

memos.title: Re: the vending robot that never reported back
memos.body: Darkmatter mentioned 'a field merchandiser lost on arrival' and asked whether OmniScrap units are ever 'inventory'. We said no, ours have Clause 44. Darkmatter laughed for eleven seconds, then asked to see Clause 44. HR sent it. Darkmatter sent back a red-lined copy titled CLAUSE 0. HR has asked for a transfer.
